Media Converter bundles static FFmpeg/ffprobe binaries as an external
executable. The binaries are licensed under the GNU GPL version 2 or later
(they are configured with `--enable-gpl` and statically link GPL-licensed
encoder libraries such as libx264 and libx265).

To fulfil the source-availability obligation of the GPL for these binaries,
their exact provenance is recorded below. At install time `pnpm ffmpeg:prepare`
sha256-verifies each downloaded **archive** before extraction, so the `ffmpeg`/
`ffprobe` executables that get shipped are unmodified:

  * macOS (pinned builds) — verified against the immutable hashes recorded in
    `scripts/ffmpeg/sources.json`.
  * Windows and Linux (rolling builds) — verified against the sha256 the
    publisher (BtbN) publishes for the exact artifact in the `latest` release
    (`checksums.sha256`), fetched over HTTPS from the same release; the local
    cache keeps a `.sha256` stamp per downloaded archive. When prepared
    natively, the extracted binaries are additionally asserted to be a static
    GPL build.

Corresponding source:

  * Upstream FFmpeg source (release matching each binary):
      macOS arm64  - FFmpeg 9.0   https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-9.0.tar.xz
      macOS x64    - FFmpeg 8.0   https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-8.0.tar.xz
      Windows x64  - FFmpeg master (BtbN `latest` rolling build)
                     https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds
      Linux x64    - FFmpeg master (BtbN `latest` rolling build)
                     https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds
  * Build recipes / third-party encoder sources are published by the binary
    providers: https://www.osxexperts.net (macOS) and
    https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds (Windows/Linux).

Binary provenance and hashes:

  * darwin-arm64  ffmpeg/ffprobe 9.0 (built 2026-07-07)
      https://www.osxexperts.net/ffmpeg9arm.zip    sha256 d0c06c5c68ce48af3143b262f7a9118a7c9f67de1e237fcc24ffb14df9c67af9
      https://www.osxexperts.net/ffprobe9arm.zip   sha256 0c94fbdd8917022f28115eca512196cf4648732bc9e5db9ec8896c7e519d02aa
  * darwin-x64    ffmpeg/ffprobe 8.0
      https://www.osxexperts.net/ffmpeg80intel.zip  sha256 2d24d22db78c87f394a5822867acd5c5dc5e762cd261a44bd26923f3a5af3e07
      https://www.osxexperts.net/ffprobe80intel.zip sha256 0b6576104a95c1b39d4939e2df86f8f7cf1d55287ff57da48777d94605d12feb
  * win32-x64     ffmpeg.exe + ffprobe.exe (static GPL build, rolling)
      https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases/download/latest/ffmpeg-master-latest-win64-gpl.zip
      sha256: the value published for this artifact in the same release's
      `checksums.sha256` at download time (a dated autobuild would expire, so
      the per-build hash is not pinned in this file).
  * linux-x64     ffmpeg/ffprobe (static GPL build, rolling)
      https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases/download/latest/ffmpeg-master-latest-linux64-gpl.tar.xz
      sha256: the value published for this artifact in the same release's
      `checksums.sha256` at download time (see above).

The exact configure line used by each binary can be inspected with
`ffmpeg -buildconf` on the shipped executable.

A written offer for the corresponding source is available on request from the
Media Converter contributors. This file, the license text
(COPYING.GPLv2) and this notice are distributed alongside the binaries in the
application bundle so recipients receive them together as the GPL requires.
